Taylor (sales): heads-up — live POC for ClearShop failed with a 413 when they POSTed product JSON + images in one body.
Nora (solutions): roughly how big was the payload?
Taylor (sales): customer reported ~7MB, base64 PNGs inline. curl shows `413 Request Entity Too Large`.
Ibrahim (engineer): That sounds like the edge body_limit (hosted demo defaults ~5MB). Quick fixes: presign images, gzip the payload with Content-Encoding header, or split into multiple requests.
Nora (solutions): customer wants a single-click demo though. Can we do a short-term config change?
Jun (oncall): I can approve a temporary bump for a narrow window if you provide tenant id and time. Prefer presign as follow-up.
Taylor (sales): tenant clearshop-demo-3, window Fri 2026-03-26 18:00-18:20 UTC. I'll file the ticket now.
InfraBot: config change requested: set body_limit=12MB for tenant clearshop-demo-3 between 2026-03-26T18:00:00Z and 2026-03-26T18:20:00Z. awaiting oncall.
Jun (oncall): approved and scheduled. I'll watch logs during the window.
Ibrahim (engineer): also recommend using the `rwd-3-xlong` model variant if they need >8k tokens — avoids textual truncation.
Nora (solutions): I'll send a short doc: presign pattern, gzip example (Content-Encoding: gzip), client chunking snippet, and model-variant notes.
Taylor (sales): demo ran fine after the bump. customer accepted presign pattern for production. closing loop. :white_check_mark:
